text.title: Private furnished homestay near Cochin International Airport
text.body: The Upper Crest Homestay is a private furnished whole-property stay in Poikattusserry, Aluva, Kerala, close to Cochin International Airport. The property includes a furnished bedroom with attached bathroom, living room, dining area, equipped kitchen, air conditioning, Wi-Fi, balcony, parking, washing machine, hot water and solar power backup. It is suitable for families, business travellers, airport stopovers and longer peaceful stays near Kochi Airport.

review.author: kumar genius
review.body: Stayed at Upper Crest Homestay near Cochin International Airport. The living room and bedroom were spacious and everything was neatly maintained. It is set in a quiet, village-like interior area yet very close to the airport. A perfect base for business meetings in Kochi and for one-day trips to Ernakulam, Thrissur, Kottayam, and Idukki.

review.author: harikrishna chandran
review.body: The property is extremely neat and the way they treated us was awesome. Calm and spacious interiors.

review.author: Pramod P. P
review.body: I had a wonderful stay at Upper Crest Homestay near Cochin Airport. The rooms were exceptionally clean, spacious, and well-maintained, providing a comfortable and relaxing experience. The hosts were warm, welcoming, and always ready to help, making us feel at home from the moment we arrived. Its convenient location, just a few minutes from the airport, makes it an excellent choice for both transit travelers and families. I highly recommend Upper Crest to anyone looking for a peaceful, comfortable, and value-for-money stay near Cochin Airport. Definitely looking forward to staying here again.
